Proposition
Source: topping:page-0010 ↗ topping-intro-flow-field 1. ch1:2.1–ch1:2.3\group ricci-solitons

For a smooth function $\sigma (t)$ and \[ \hat g(t)=\sigma (t)\psi _t^*(g(t)), \] one has \[ \frac{\partial \hat g}{\partial t} =\sigma '(t)\psi _t^*(g) +\sigma (t)\psi _t^*\! \left(\frac{\partial g}{\partial t}\right) +\sigma (t)\psi _t^*(\mathcal L_Xg). \]

Proof

\sketch Apply the product rule and the pullback derivative identity $\frac{d}{dt}\psi _t^*g=\psi _t^*(\mathcal L_Xg)$, with the time dependence of $g$ contributing the middle term.

□
